text:
Lina M: Quick sync: HW partner (EdgeWave) reported duplicate meter records and late-claim spikes last quarter. We need a formal duplicate-detection + late-claim policy so partners know how we handle corrections and payouts.
Omar Z: Yup saw that. Root cause looked like edge device retries + intermittent acks causing replays. Two problems: (1) idempotency key not consistently set on older firmware, (2) late events arriving after daily rollups.
Priya S: Proposal: canonical event id = sha256(customer_id + device_id + event_ts + sequence_no) if sequence_no exists; fallback to sha256(payload) as last resort. Reject duplicates in ingestion if id seen within retention window.
Ethan G: Retention window? For hardware partners we probably need 30 days for disputes. But we should keep a short fast-path cache for 48h to avoid memory blowups and a durable dedupe store for 30d.
Jasmin R: Billing asks: when we drop duplicates or mark late events, how do we reflect this in partner statements? They want an explicit line item: "late_claim_adjustment" with original_event_id, corrected_units, and adjustment_amount.
Lina M: Agree. Policy draft: 
- Dedup window: 30 days logical, with two layers: 48h fast cache + 30d dedupe index.
- Late claim cut-off: auto-accept late events within 7 days and apply to current month; after 7 days require partner-initiated dispute and manual review.
- Adjustment visibility: every adjustment emits `partner_statement_line` and `proration_audit` entries for legal.
Omar Z: Edge case: what if partner resends corrected events (same id but changed payload)? We'll accept if event has `correction=true` flag and a newer `received_at`. Otherwise ignore.
Priya S: Implementation notes: ingestion pipeline will calculate `canonical_id` and tag `is_duplicate`. Pseudocode: ```python
def canonical_id(e):
    if e.sequence_no:
        key = f"{e.customer_id}:{e.device_id}:{e.sequence_no}"
    else:
        key = sha256(e.payload)
    return sha256(key)
```
Ethan G: We'll expose metrics: `dedupe_rate`, `late_event_rate`, `correction_acceptance_rate`, and `manual_adjustments_per_week`. Set alert if dedupe_rate > 1% for any partner for 1h.
Jasmin R: For payouts, adjustments within 7 days are auto-applied and will show in next payout cycle. Adjustments beyond 7 days go to a manual review queue and will not be paid until approved. Need SLA: manual reviews completed within 5 business days.
Lina M: Testing: need a hardware simulator to produce duplicates and corrected events. Also test sequence_no gaps and sequence_no reuse. Priya can add tests to ingestion-sim.
Priya S: Will add cases: 
1) exact duplicate within 30s -> drop
2) duplicate after rollup but within 3 days -> accept as correction if `correction=true`
3) late event 10 days after window -> route to manual queue
4) sequence_no reuse due to device reboot -> require monotonicity check per device-session id
Omar Z: We also need a partner-facing API to query `event_status` and `statement_history` so partners can reconcile without opening tickets. That API should return idempotency status and any adjustments.
Ethan G: Security note: canonical_id computation must avoid secrets. Keep all IDs hashed with a stable salt stored in KMS. Also log-only mode for first 2 weeks of rollout.
Jasmin R: Communication snippet for partners: 
"Wehave implemented duplicate-detection and late-claim handling. Events arriving within 7 days will be auto-applied; after 7 days they require manual review. Please include sequence_no and correction=true flags to help us process corrections quickly."
Lina M: Rollout plan: 
- Week A: implement canonical_id + fast cache in staging (Priya)
- Week B: durable dedupe index + metrics + API (Omar + Ethan)
- Week C: run simulated partner test, enable log-only for 2 weeks (Partners + SE)
- Week D: enable enforcement, publish partner docs and SLA (Partnerships + Billing)
Jasmin R: Billing will create adjustment ledger lines and ensure partner statements include `adjustment_reference` linking to immutable audit records.
Omar Z: Ops: add a throttled re-ingest path so partners can resend corrected events without causing spikes; set RPS limits per partner.
Priya S: Blocker: need member from data infra to approve the 30d dedupe index storage (I filed an infra ticket).
Ethan G: I'll own the metrics + API endpoints. Will add dashboards: dedupe heatmap by partner, late-claim backlog.
Lina M: All right please ack here and add any missing edgecases. Thanks.
meter-bot: detected spikes for EdgeWave: dedupe_rate=1.9% over last 2h, created incident INC-2024-1187 for eng-ingest.
Omar Z: Acks. I'll pause enforcement on EdgeWave until we deploy the fast cache patch.
Priya S: Ack. Starting simulator tests today.
Jasmin R: Ack. Billing will draft the partner statement example.
Lina M: Thanks team — I'll collate this into a formal policy doc and post a partner notice draft by Friday.
